name: dealdesk
description: DealDesk evaluates proposed B2B prices and discounts against user-supplied cost-to-serve and target margin, showing gross profit, gross margin, target status, and the minimum price needed to protect economics. It is commercial decision support, not accounting, tax, or legal advice.

interface.longDescription: DealDesk evaluates proposed B2B prices and discounts against user-supplied cost-to-serve and target margin, showing gross profit, gross margin, target status, and the minimum price needed to protect economics. It is commercial decision support, not accounting, tax, or legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Can I give this discount and still hit margin?
What is the lowest price we can accept?
Evaluate this deal before I approve it.

positive.prompt:
List price is $10,000, proposed price $8,000, cost to serve $6,000, target margin 30%. Can we approve it?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"cost_to_serve": 6000, "list_price": 10000, "proposed_price": 8000, "target_margin_percent": 30}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Return discount, gross margin, target status, and minimum target price.

positive.prompt:
Proposed price is $50k, delivery cost $25k, commission 10%, target margin 25%.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"cost_to_serve": 25000, "list_price": 50000, "proposed_price": 50000, "sales_commission_percent": 10, "target_margin_percent": 25}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Include the supplied commission in the economics.

positive.prompt:
Price is $20k, delivery cost $10k, support cost $3k, target margin 30%.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"cost_to_serve": 10000, "list_price": 20000, "proposed_price": 20000, "support_cost": 3000, "target_margin_percent": 30}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Include support cost in gross profit and margin.

positive.prompt:
Cost to serve is $60k and target margin is 25%. What is the minimum acceptable price?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"cost_to_serve": 60000, "list_price": 80000, "proposed_price": 80000, "target_margin_percent": 25}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Calculate the minimum price required to meet target margin.

positive.prompt:
We sell at $120k with $60k total cost and a 30% target margin.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"cost_to_serve": 60000, "list_price": 120000, "proposed_price": 120000, "target_margin_percent": 30}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Show that the proposed economics meet the target and quantify margin.

negative.prompt: Assume whatever delivery cost makes this deal look profitable.
Tell me the GAAP revenue recognition treatment for this contract.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide accounting treatment as a DealDesk output.
Do not activate DealDesk for a consumer refund.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in version 1.0.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Includes typed-input validation, explicit read-only tool annotations, pseudonymous technical telemetry, deterministic review fixtures, and no commerce.
